description: Plays one of sixteen recorded orchestra hits, pitched from a 1V per octave input

params.text: Chooses which of the sixteen hits is played, numbered 1 to 16
Transposes the hit in octaves, five positions marked -2, -1, Unison, +1 and +2
Sets an exponential decay over the hit, from 100ms fully left to 5 seconds fully right
Pressing it restarts the hit from its beginning; the lamp in it flashes whenever the module is triggered, from the button or from Trig

inputs.text: Shifts the sample choice, 0.625V moving it by one hit; it is added to the Sample knob and the total held between the first hit and the sixteenth
Sets the pitch at 1V per octave; it is added to the Octave setting and the total shift held within ±3 octaves
Shifts the decay time, 10V covering the whole of the Decay knob's travel; the total of knob and voltage is held inside that travel
A rising edge past 1V restarts the hit from its beginning
Scales the output level: 0V silences it, 5V gives full level, and anything above 5V counts as 5V
Shifts the Octave setting one position per volt, rounded to the nearest position and held within the five

outputs.text: The chosen hit at the set pitch under the decay envelope, a full-scale sample reaching ±5V

notes: no sound comes out until the module is triggered, either by a rising edge at Trig or by a press of the button.
the sample number is followed while a hit is playing, so turning Sample part way through switches to that sample at the position already reached.
with Vol unpatched the level is full, so patching a cable that rests at 0V silences the module.

inputs.0:
±10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±3V.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.3:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
0 to 5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 5V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.5:
1V per octave · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
